zynismus.log.wende: U-turn on “{name}”: people believe the government less
zynismus.log.geschenk: Election gift “{name}”: many see the intent
zynismus.warum.wende: Reversing a measure soon after changing it costs credibility (cynicism). It fades over months.
zynismus.warum.geschenk: Costly increases in the last six months before the election look like buying votes; some voters punish it.
bilanz.zynismus.name: Cynicism
bilanz.zynismus.text: U-turns and election gifts cost credibility; cynicism fades over months.
